notes: Real-time PACE prices from California ISO OASIS PRC_RTPD_LMP (15-minute market), node ELAP_PACE-APND.
Mountain days run local midnight to local midnight and are keyed by UTC interval start: 96 intervals, 100 on Nov 2 2025 and 92 on Mar 8 2026.
Missing intervals are null and listed in `missing`, never filled.
RT proxy: EDAM's day-ahead market did not exist before May 1 2026, so these winter real-time prices have no day-ahead counterpart.
